text:
release-coordinator: rolling v2026.3 into eu1 now, staged 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m. deploy-bot kicked off canary on pool-eu1-rc1 :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary instances launched, smoke probes enabled (kv-prefill, heartbeat, embed-route). will post probe summaries.
release-coordinator: quick heads-up — this change includes a batching tweak and a warmup-timing change that might affect initial probe p95. keep an eye on warmup probes.
sre-jake: noted. i'll watch p95 and probe-failure-rate. if we see >5% synth fails at 10% we should pause.
maria: seeing probe noise already, small spike in kv-prefill misses, looks like repeated early retries from synth agent. sharing logs:```
[2026-03-22T14:12:09Z] synth-agent eu1 canary-1 curl /_probe/kv  -> 200, latency 120ms
[2026-03-22T14:12:10Z] synth-agent eu1 canary-1 curl /_probe/kv  -> 503, retry triggered
[2026-03-22T14:12:11Z] synth-agent eu1 canary-1 curl /_probe/kv  -> 200
```
ash: that pattern looks like a short spike followed by immediate retries that amplify the apparent failure rate (oscillation). can we debounce retries on synth agent?
release-coordinator: good catch. current synth config is retry=3, backoff=0.5s. i'm proposing we debounce to backoff=2s and add a 15s warmup grace window for canaries. thoughts?
sre-jake: +1 to grace window. the warmup should let caches populate and avoid false positives. debounce backoff 2s seems fine.
maria: if we change synth config mid-rollout, should we pause the canary, update config, and then resume?
karen: we can patch synth config via deploy-bot staged config rollout. suggest pause at 10%, push synth-config v1.0.1 with debounce/backoff changes, then resume to 50%.
ash: timeline? patch deploy-bot config now and resume in ~5m?
deploy-bot: received command: pause-rollout v2026.3 at 10%. Applying: setting synth-agent config -> debounce_backoff=2s, initial_grace=15s. will restart synth-agent on canary nodes.
release-coordinator: paused. applying config change now. i'll post when synth-agent restarts and first healthy probe comes back.
(~~ 40s later ~~)
deploy-bot: synth-agent restart complete on canary nodes. first probe results:```
curl https://eu1-canary/_probe/kv -> 200 p95 140ms
curl https://eu1-canary/_probe/heartbeat -> 200 p95 95ms
curl https://eu1-canary/_probe/embed -> 200 p95 180ms
probe-failure-rate last 5m: 0.7%
```
maria: much better, noise looks suppressed. no longer seeing quick retry spikes.
sre-jake: recommend resume to 50% now and monitor 10m window for tail latency regressions. set alert if probe-failure-rate > 2% or p95 delta > +20% vs baseline.
nash: i'll watch traces and KV cache warmup traces. if we see persistent +30% p95, we'll pin back to v2026.2.
release-coordinator: resuming to 50% now. deploy-bot proceeding. please ack on monitoring. :thumbsup:
karen: ack. updating release notes to mention synth debounce and warmup grace so ops knows why we changed probes.
maria: also adding a quicknote in the runbook: "if synth noise recurs, increase initial_grace to 30s before pinning."
ash: fine by me.
release-coordinator: summary: pause at 10% due to probe oscillation, applied synth debounce_backoff=2s and initial_grace=15s, restarted synth agents, resumed rollout to 50%. monitoring window active until +10m. will call pin/rollback if thresholds breached.
sre-jake: thanks all.
release-coordinator: closing thread unless anyone sees new anomalies.
